overview_description.description:
OrgOrg is a community of people who work in a field sometimes known as business/people operations.

OrgOrg is an "Organization Organizers" - the folks behind the scenes makin' it all work at work. We are a community of like-jobbed individuals, sharing best practices and war stories because we know that it's better not to go it alone. 

OrgOrg (the organization) provides a forum for discussion, as well as resources, events, and more! Our over 2,600 members span the globe, and we're constantly growing.
